+## The whole compiler as one Rian artifact
+
+[`examples/rian/selfhost_calc.rian`](examples/rian/selfhost_calc.rian) unifies
+every layer — lexer, parser, optimizer, code generator, stack VM — into a
+**single self-contained Rian module** that compiles to **one real `.beam`** and
+turns source text straight into a value:
+
+```text
+run("1 + 2 * (3 - 4)")  =  -1        run("(2 + 3) * 4")  =  20
+String -> Vec(Token) -> Expr -> Expr(folded) -> Vec(Instr) -> Int64
+```
+
+This is the front-to-back pipeline as one artifact, written entirely in Rian and
+compiled by the abstract-forms backend — no `eval`, no per-stage test glue. The
+optimizer is in-line: a constant program folds to a single instruction
+(`emit("2 + 3 * 4") == [Push(14)]`). It is the strongest single piece of evidence
+that the toolchain compiles a real, multi-pass compiler written in its own
+language.

+# ===========================================================================
+# SELF-HOSTING — the whole calc compiler, in ONE Rian module
+# ===========================================================================
+# Goal (ADR-0027/0031): tie every spike layer — lexer, parser, optimizer, code
+# generator, stack VM — into a single self-contained Rian program that compiles
+# to one real `.beam` and turns SOURCE TEXT into a value:
+#
+#     run("1 + 2 * (3 - 4)")  =  -1
+#     run("(2 + 3) * 4")      =  20
+#
+# This is the front-to-back pipeline as one artifact, written entirely in Rian:
+#   String -> Vec(Token) -> Expr -> Expr(folded) -> Vec(Instr) -> Int64
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+mod SelfhostCalc do
+  # ── tokens ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+  type Token := TNum(Int64) | TPlus | TMinus | TStar | TSlash | TLParen | TRParen
+
+  # ── the expression tree (the parser builds the arithmetic subset; the
+  #    optimizer/codegen also handle variables and `let`) ─────────────────
+  type Expr := Num(Int64)
+             | Var(String)
+             | Add(Expr, Expr)
+             | Sub(Expr, Expr)
+             | Mul(Expr, Expr)
+             | Div(Expr, Expr)
+             | Let(String, Expr, Expr)
+
+  # one parse step: the node built so far + the unconsumed tokens
+  type Parse := P(Expr, Vec(Token))
+
+  # ── stack-machine instructions ────────────────────────────────────────
+  type Instr := Push(Int64) | Load(Int64) | Store(Int64) | IAdd | ISub | IMul | IDiv
+
+  # ── the driver: source text straight to a value ───────────────────────
+  pub def run(src String) Int64 := vm(compile(fold(parse(lex(String.to_charlist(src))))))
+
+  # compile to instructions (constant-folded first), for inspection
+  pub def emit(src String) Vec(Instr) := compile(fold(parse(lex(String.to_charlist(src)))))
+
+  # ── lexer:  Vec(Int64 codepoints) -> Vec(Token) ───────────────────────
+  def lex(cs Vec(Int64)) Vec(Token)
+  def lex([]) := []
+  def lex([c | rest]) when c == 32 := lex(rest)
+  def lex([43 | rest]) := [TPlus | lex(rest)]
+  def lex([45 | rest]) := [TMinus | lex(rest)]
+  def lex([42 | rest]) := [TStar | lex(rest)]
+  def lex([47 | rest]) := [TSlash | lex(rest)]
+  def lex([40 | rest]) := [TLParen | lex(rest)]
+  def lex([41 | rest]) := [TRParen | lex(rest)]
+  def lex([c | rest]) when c >= 48 and c <= 57 := lex_num([c | rest], 0)
+  def lex([_ | rest]) := lex(rest)
+
+  def lex_num(cs Vec(Int64), acc Int64) Vec(Token)
+  def lex_num([c | rest], acc) when c >= 48 and c <= 57 := lex_num(rest, acc * 10 + c - 48)
+  def lex_num(cs, acc) := [TNum(acc) | lex(cs)]
+
+  # ── parser:  precedence climbing over `+ - * /` with parentheses ───────
+  pub def parse(ts Vec(Token)) Expr
+  pub def parse(ts)
+    case parse_expr(ts) do
+      P(e, _) -> e
+    end
+  end
+
+  def parse_expr(ts Vec(Token)) Parse
+  def parse_expr(ts)
+    case parse_term(ts) do
+      P(left, rest) -> parse_expr_tail(left, rest)
+    end
+  end
+
+  def parse_expr_tail(left Expr, ts Vec(Token)) Parse
+  def parse_expr_tail(left, [TPlus | rest])
+    case parse_term(rest) do
+      P(right, rest2) -> parse_expr_tail(Add(left, right), rest2)
+    end
+  end
+  def parse_expr_tail(left, [TMinus | rest])
+    case parse_term(rest) do
+      P(right, rest2) -> parse_expr_tail(Sub(left, right), rest2)
+    end
+  end
+  def parse_expr_tail(left, ts) := P(left, ts)
+
+  def parse_term(ts Vec(Token)) Parse
+  def parse_term(ts)
+    case parse_factor(ts) do
+      P(left, rest) -> parse_term_tail(left, rest)
+    end
+  end
+
+  def parse_term_tail(left Expr, ts Vec(Token)) Parse
+  def parse_term_tail(left, [TStar | rest])
+    case parse_factor(rest) do
+      P(right, rest2) -> parse_term_tail(Mul(left, right), rest2)
+    end
+  end
+  def parse_term_tail(left, [TSlash | rest])
+    case parse_factor(rest) do
+      P(right, rest2) -> parse_term_tail(Div(left, right), rest2)
+    end
+  end
+  def parse_term_tail(left, ts) := P(left, ts)
+
+  def parse_factor(ts Vec(Token)) Parse
+  def parse_factor([TNum(n) | rest]) := P(Num(n), rest)
+  def parse_factor([TLParen | rest])
+    case parse_expr(rest) do
+      P(e, [TRParen | rest2]) -> P(e, rest2)
+    end
+  end
+
+  # ── optimizer:  constant folding + algebraic identities ───────────────
+  pub def fold(e Expr) Expr
+  pub def fold(Num(n)) := Num(n)
+  pub def fold(Var(x)) := Var(x)
+  pub def fold(Add(a, b)) := fadd(fold(a), fold(b))
+  pub def fold(Sub(a, b)) := fsub(fold(a), fold(b))
+  pub def fold(Mul(a, b)) := fmul(fold(a), fold(b))
+  pub def fold(Div(a, b)) := fdiv(fold(a), fold(b))
+  pub def fold(Let(name, rhs, body)) := Let(name, fold(rhs), fold(body))
+
+  def fadd(l Expr, r Expr) Expr
+  def fadd(Num(a), Num(b)) := Num(a + b)
+  def fadd(Num(0), b) := b
+  def fadd(a, Num(0)) := a
+  def fadd(a, b) := Add(a, b)
+
+  def fsub(l Expr, r Expr) Expr
+  def fsub(Num(a), Num(b)) := Num(a - b)
+  def fsub(a, Num(0)) := a
+  def fsub(a, b) := Sub(a, b)
+
+  def fmul(l Expr, r Expr) Expr
+  def fmul(Num(a), Num(b)) := Num(a * b)
+  def fmul(Num(0), _) := Num(0)
+  def fmul(_, Num(0)) := Num(0)
+  def fmul(Num(1), b) := b
+  def fmul(a, Num(1)) := a
+  def fmul(a, b) := Mul(a, b)
+
+  def fdiv(l Expr, r Expr) Expr
+  def fdiv(Num(a), Num(b)) := Num(a div b)
+  def fdiv(a, Num(1)) := a
+  def fdiv(a, b) := Div(a, b)
+
+  # ── code generator:  Expr -> Vec(Instr) with load/store slots ─────────
+  def compile(e Expr) Vec(Instr) := g(e, %{}, 0)
+
+  def g(e Expr, env Map(String, Int64), depth Int64) Vec(Instr)
+  def g(Num(n), _, _) := [Push(n)]
+  def g(Var(name), env, _) := [Load(Map.get(env, name))]
+  def g(Add(a, b), env, d) := gbin(a, b, env, d, IAdd)
+  def g(Sub(a, b), env, d) := gbin(a, b, env, d, ISub)
+  def g(Mul(a, b), env, d) := gbin(a, b, env, d, IMul)
+  def g(Div(a, b), env, d) := gbin(a, b, env, d, IDiv)
+  def g(Let(name, rhs, body), env, d)
+    concat(g(rhs, env, d), concat([Store(d)], g(body, Map.put(env, name, d), d + 1)))
+  end
+
+  def gbin(a Expr, b Expr, env Map(String, Int64), d Int64, op Instr) Vec(Instr)
+  def gbin(a, b, env, d, op) := concat(g(a, env, d), concat(g(b, env, d), [op]))
+
+  def concat(xs Vec(Instr), ys Vec(Instr)) Vec(Instr)
+  def concat([], ys) := ys
+  def concat([h | t], ys) := [h | concat(t, ys)]
+
+  # ── stack VM:  Vec(Instr) -> Int64 ────────────────────────────────────
+  def vm(prog Vec(Instr)) Int64 := exec(prog, [], %{})
+
+  def exec(prog Vec(Instr), stack Vec(Int64), slots Map(Int64, Int64)) Int64
+  def exec([], [top | _], _) := top
+  def exec([Push(n) | r], st, sl) := exec(r, [n | st], sl)
+  def exec([Load(i) | r], st, sl) := exec(r, [Map.get(sl, i) | st], sl)
+  def exec([Store(i) | r], [v | st], sl) := exec(r, st, Map.put(sl, i, v))
+  def exec([IAdd | r], [b, a | st], sl) := exec(r, [a + b | st], sl)
+  def exec([ISub | r], [b, a | st], sl) := exec(r, [a - b | st], sl)
+  def exec([IMul | r], [b, a | st], sl) := exec(r, [a * b | st], sl)
+  def exec([IDiv | r], [b, a | st], sl) := exec(r, [a div b | st], sl)
+end

+    test "the whole calc compiler in ONE Rian module: source string -> value on bytecode" do
+      {:ok, calc} = Beam.load(File.read!("examples/rian/selfhost_calc.rian"), :rian_beam_calc)
+
+      # one module, one .beam: lex -> parse -> fold -> codegen -> VM
+      assert calc.run("2 + 3 * 4") == 14
+      assert calc.run("1 + 2 * (3 - 4)") == -1
+      assert calc.run("(2 + 3) * 4") == 20
+      assert calc.run("10 - 3 - 2") == 5
+      assert calc.run("8 / 4 / 2") == 1
+
+      # the optimizer is in the pipeline: a constant program folds to one Push
+      assert calc.emit("2 + 3 * 4") == [{:push, 14}]
+      assert calc.emit("(2 + 3) * 4") == [{:push, 20}]
+    end
